title: Cartwise Shopper Batches Duplicate-Recovery Loyalty Allowance by Level and Service Length
content:
When a duplicate mileage posting is taken back on a Cartwise Shopper Batches batch, goodwill is applied to the full amount of the later mileage posting before anything is taken back. The duplicate loyalty allowance is subtracted from that full amount, and the amount remaining is never below zero. The allowance is:

- **1.00** for a shopper account at the Gold level or above (Full-Service Shopper Gold, Platinum or Diamond in Cartwise Shopper Contractor Accounts) that is **36 or more** whole calendar months past its first activation date;
- **0.50** for an account at the Silver level or above (Silver, Gold, Platinum or Diamond) that is **12 to 35** whole calendar months past its first activation date;
- **nothing** for every other account.

The level and the first activation date are read from the shopper's Cartwise Shopper Contractor Accounts record; the months run to the handling date.

## Level-and-service table

| Account level | Whole months since first activation | Allowance |
|---|---|---|
| Gold, Platinum or Diamond | 36 or more | 1.00 |
| Gold, Platinum or Diamond | 12 to 35 | 0.50 |
| Silver | 12 to 35 | 0.50 |
| Silver | 36 or more | Nothing |
| Any level | Fewer than 12 | Nothing |
| Shop-Only Shopper or Full-Service Shopper | Any | Nothing |

## Hypothetical cases

- A Platinum account 41 months past activation, later mileage posting 4.35: 4.35 less 1.00 leaves 3.35.
- A Silver account 20 months past activation, later posting 0.40: 0.40 less 0.50 would be negative, so the amount remaining is 0.00.
- A Gold account 8 months past activation: no allowance.
